name: 2022-2c-recuperatorio-parcial1
title: Qatar OnLine: Kick at Goal
description: Starting from the course staff's Qatar OnLine football game (20x20 board, three player kinds per team, alternating turns, die-adjusted moves and kicks, possession match-ups), the student must add, with TDD, a single #patearAlArco message: forwards and half-field midfielders score depending on die roll and distance to the opposing goal, defenders cannot kick, a goal resets positions and possession, a miss gives the ball to the opposing defender, and goals per team can be queried.

design.notes: The kick rule differs per player kind (forward threshold 10, midfielder threshold 15 only past half field, defender forbidden) and should be dispatched on the possessor rather than if-ed; the given model has no Team object and keeps players as Dictionary keys, so goal position, goal count and initial-position reset push toward introducing Equipo; the outcome changes turn/possession state.
